description: This visual was developed in partnership with Hamed Behairy - CFA.... one of top financial trainers in the world. The Radial Tree visual allows users to explore hierarchical relationships in an intuitive and engaging way. Designed for clarity and aesthetics, it arranges nodes in concentric circles, displaying parent-child connections through smooth radial links. The layout provides a balanced, symmetrical view that helps uncover patterns, dependencies, and clusters within complex datasets. Key features: • Interactive zoom and pan for exploring large hierarchies • Configurable node colors, labels, and levels • Smooth animations for expanding or collapsing branches • Ideal for organizational charts, project structures, and taxonomy visualizations Empower your data storytelling with a dynamic, radial perspective of your hierarchy. All functionalities of this visual are available for free within Power BI Desktop. In Power BI Online Service, it will show a watermark. To use the visual without watermark in Power BI Online, please purchase license subscription For more information visit https://www.excelnaccess.com/radial-tree/ or contact zubair@excelnaccess.com Would love to get your feedback on this visual.
